messages:
maya (support): Escalation from customer: intermittent 'invalid character '\x00' when using Go SDK streaming JSON mode (v0.9.1). Occurs ~1/1000 requests. Customer reproduces with concurrent goroutines sharing a stream.

maya (support) logs:
```
2026-03-04T14:12:02Z ERROR stream_handler.go:87 decode error: invalid character '\x00' looking for beginning of value
2026-03-04T14:12:02Z WARN  client.go:204 retrying request
```

sam (go-sdk): Can you paste minimal repro code and SDK options? Is compression on? Are you calling Send concurrently on same stream?

maya (support): Repro from customer:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
stream := client.StreamJSON(ctx, &redwood.StreamOptions{Model: "rw/small-json", Mode: "json"})
// multiple goroutines do:
go func() {
    // build message
    client.Send(ctx, stream, payload)
}()
// client closes later
```

maya (support): They confirm they're sharing one stream across goroutines. They say error rate rises under high concurrency.

sam (go-sdk): Likely race where encoder buffer gets interleaved/truncated -> decoder sees NUL or unexpected char. Immediate workaround: don't share stream, create per-goroutine stream or serialize Send with a mutex. I'll try to reproduce with stress test.

aj (eng-runtime): Does this appear in TS/Python SDKs? Any pattern in request sizes? compression/transfer-encoding? 

maya (support): Only seen in Go so far. Compression disabled, typical body 2-6KB, spikes to ~50KB.

sam (go-sdk): Plan: add mutex around encoder, add unit test for concurrent Send, bump to v0.9.2. If regression, also add validation in server-side JSON streaming. CCing @eng-runtime for coordination.

ci-bot: Created issue: go-sdk#834 - 'concurrent StreamJSON Send -> invalid JSON'
